# Rilla Blythe

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v5 c7 P3](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0003)</sub>
- **Origin:** Ingleside  <sub>[v5 c7 P0](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0000), [v5 c7 P3](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0003)</sub>

## Appearance

Rilla Blythe has long, sleek, and round ruddy curls. She is dressed daintily in a starched white embroidered dress with a blue sash and beaded slippers. She wears an elaborate best hat made of silk, lace, and flowers.

_Sources: [v5 c7 P1](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0001)_

## Personality

Rilla takes great pride in her fine clothing and delights in its splendour. She is resolute and dutiful in following instructions given to her. Though easily terrified when confronted, she remains staunch in her responsibilities until her courage breaks.

_Sources: [v5 c7 P0](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0000), [v5 c7 P1](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0001), [v5 c7 P12](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0012), [v5 c7 P14](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0014)_

## Traits

- Proud  <sub>[v5 c7 P0](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0000)</sub>
- Conscious of her clothes  <sub>[v5 c7 P1](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0001)</sub>
- Staunch  <sub>[v5 c7 P12](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0012)</sub>

## History

Rilla was sent on an errand from Ingleside by Susan to deliver a small basket of early strawberries directly to Mr. Meredith or Aunt Martha. Dressed up in her best hat and clothes, she walked up the manse hill where she encountered Mary Vance. When Mary demanded the basket, Rilla refused to hand it over in accordance with Susan's instructions. Mary then taunted Rilla for being dressed like a doll baby and executed a wild dance around her. After Rilla tried to edge away, Mary grabbed a large dried codfish from a nearby drying rack and chased Rilla down the hill while brandishing it. Terrified, Rilla dropped the basket, causing the strawberries to spill on the road as she fled through the street of the Glen with Mary in pursuit.

_Sources: [v5 c7 P0](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0000), [v5 c7 P1](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0001), [v5 c7 P3](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0003), [v5 c7 P4](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0004), [v5 c7 P5](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0005), [v5 c7 P7](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0007), [v5 c7 P9](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0009), [v5 c7 P10](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0010), [v5 c7 P13](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0013), [v5 c7 P14](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0014), [v5 c7 P15](../source/v05-c07.md#nw-v05-c07-p0015)_
